title: RealmJoin Runbook Permissions
description: Describes the permissions a RealmJoin runbook requires: API permissions (app role assignments) for the Automation Account's managed identity, Microsoft Entra directory roles, and permissions that have to be assigned manually.

SchemaVersion.description: Version of the permissions file schema. Current version: 2.

Permissions.description: API permissions (app role assignments) per resource application.

Roles.description: Microsoft Entra directory roles required by the runbook.

ManualPermissions.description: Permissions that cannot be assigned automatically and have to be set up manually. Free text, one entry per permission.

Name.description: Display name of the resource application, e.g. 'Microsoft Graph'.

Id.description: Well-known application ID of the resource application, e.g. '00000003-0000-0000-c000-000000000000' for Microsoft Graph.

AppRoleAssignments.description: App roles (application permissions) to assign on this resource. Use a plain string for a required permission, or the object form to mark a permission as optional or to document a reason.

Optional.description: True if this permission is only needed when an optional feature of the runbook is used. Defaults to false.

Feature.description: Short name of the optional feature that needs this permission, e.g. 'Email report'.

Reason.description: Why the runbook needs this permission.

Name.description: Display name of the Microsoft Entra directory role, e.g. 'User Administrator'.

TemplateId.description: roleTemplateId of the directory role. Stable across tenants, unlike the display name.

Optional.description: True if this role is only needed when an optional feature of the runbook is used. Defaults to false.

Feature.description: Short name of the optional feature that needs this role.

Reason.description: Why the runbook needs this role.
